assertions: Actual package input References feed shared XML conversion and native Writer context/resource parsing.
record.capability: Actual OOXML package input references through shared SAX and Writer resource parsing
gaps: Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER200 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved.
